items.title: StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
items.summary_en: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. items.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?

items.title: What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution
items.summary_en: Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic selecting the heads measures bias.
